description:
List top losing tokens by 24h price change percentage on the Stacks ecosystem. Useful for identifying underperforming assets or potential reversal candidates. Powered by the Tenero API (api.tenero.io). No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

chain.description: Chain to query: stacks, spark, or sportsfun (default: stacks)

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return (default: 10, max: 50)

name: tenero_top_losers
